items.title: The D'Angelo Russell and Javale Mcgee show in the CBA is over as the Shanghai Sharks break the pair up and waive Javale Mcgee after just playing 8 games.
items.author: justusinreddit
items.body_excerpt: The D'Angelo Russell and Javale Mcgee pairing in the CBA is over as the Shanghai Sharks waive Javale Mcgee after just playing 8 games. JaVale McGee 's stint in China has come to an end. The Shanghai Sharks have waived McGee after eight games this season. In his eight appearances…
